author: ttravis786
body:
Adds the input files for the HGCal neural-network common-mode (CM) correction, required for https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/52377 .

New files in `CMCalibrations/` 

- `cm_dnn_multimodule_zscore.pth`: TorchScript model with z-score normalisation (default)
- `cm_dnn_multimodule_zscore_manifest.json`: input feature order for the z-score model
- `cm_dnn_multimodule_zscore_preprocessing.json`: normalisation parameters for the z-score model
- `cm_dnn_multimodule.pth`: TorchScript model without normalisation
- `cm_dnn_multimodule_manifest.json`: input feature order for the plain model
- `cellareas.json`: cell-area fractions used as an NN input
- `README.md`: description of the files

Details on the models: https://indico.cern.ch/event/1718533/#sc-8-8-noise-mitigation

No existing files are changed. Validation is described in the CMSSW PR.

The HGCAL CM NN correction PR is explained in full detail here https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/52377
title: Added necessary config files for HGCAL CM correction
